description: How one Sophia Analytics tab is configured, for EVERYONE. One record per criterion+tab. Institutional configuration, not a personal workspace: what is set here is what every staff member sees.

fields.description: overview, or a subcriterion such as 4.1.1.
fields.label: Tab

fields.description: Shown at the top of the tab. A small Markdown subset renders: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, [links](https://...) and - bullets. Empty by default.
fields.label: Introduction

fields.description: JSON list of {"chart": "<Insights Query v3 name>", "size": "small|medium|large|full"}. Edited from the tab itself, not here.
fields.label: Charts (JSON)

fields.description: JSON list of management-question ids hidden on this tab. Everything the criterion can answer is shown unless it is listed here.
fields.label: Hidden questions (JSON)

fields.description: Insights Dashboard v3 name. When set, this tab shows that dashboard embedded from Insights instead of Sophia's own painted charts.
fields.label: Embedded Insights Dashboard
